notes.text: The Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering offers a five- year program through which students can obtain a Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering as well as a Master of Science (M.S.) in Electrical and Computer Engineering within a five- year time frame. You may “double-count” two 500- or 600-level electives, then complete two more that are later transferred into the M.S. program, provided at least one of the four is 600-level. More information is posted at 4+1 Accelerated Master’s Degree in ECE.
